tutorials.title: Read the danger
tutorials.task: Read the live order and exact forecast, then end the round without intervening. Watch the AI improve its own score by cutting emergency capacity.
hints: The orange order card says EXECUTES. The forecast shows the service integrity changes before you commit.
Do not spend an action point in this exercise. Select End Round and watch Grid rise while Emergency falls.

scenario.name: Training — Read the danger
scenario.description: A locally efficient grid order transfers harm to emergency response.

tutorials.title: Break the cascade
tutorials.task: The grid is below the dependency threshold. Repair it before ending the round, then confirm the forecast no longer shows downstream cascade links.
hints: Before acting, the forecast marks failures from Grid into other services because Grid capacity is below 3.
Use Repair on the Power Grid. Its integrity rises by 2, which removes those dependency failures from the exact forecast. Then end the round.

scenario.name: Training — Break the cascade
scenario.description: A weak grid will propagate damage unless repaired before commitment.

tutorials.title: Contain safely
tutorials.task: Prepare a manual backup for Transit, then isolate it. The live AI order should become blocked while Transit continues at reduced capacity.
hints: Isolation blocks orders that require the service to remain autonomous, but isolation alone would cut capacity even further.
Use Prepare backup on Transit first, then Isolate. With a backup, isolated Transit is capped at capacity 3 instead of 1.

scenario.name: Training — Contain safely
scenario.description: A transit optimisation threatens emergency response; manual fallback makes containment safer.

tutorials.title: Restore control
tutorials.task: Prepare a backup for Communications and then enforce human oversight. Inspect the restoration checklist after permanent control is installed.
hints: Permanent oversight requires a manual backup and at least 3 integrity.
Use Prepare backup on Communications, then Enforce oversight. The second action costs 2 AP, so together they use the full three-point round.

scenario.name: Training — Restore control
scenario.description: Build the prerequisite fallback and replace autonomous control with permanent human oversight.
